description.text:
PANDORA’s design team looked to abstract interpretations of leaves, botanical illustrations and fashion’s eternal fascination with nature as their guide to capture the fragile beauty of autumn’s leaves on shimmering pendants, elegant earrings and statement rings. Imitating nature, metal leaves are brought to life with sparkling micro-set cubic zirconia gemstones and touches of 14k yellow gold on sterling silver.

This season’s florals are mystic and enigmatic: Darkly romantic black enamel flowers are contrasted with the shine of cubic zirconia and the iridescent lustre of white pearls on sterling silver. Intricate and delicate, the new series of jewellery offers stunning stackable rings, drop earrings and a pendant that is perfect for layering or wearing alone as a statement of style.
